title: Elev8 All Glass Vapour Tamer
description:
Elev8 All Glass Vapour Tamer
Mix things up with this vapour tamer by Elev8. This vapour tamer uses glass balls to create a whole lot of turbulence as your vapour travels through the balls. The result is smooth vapour. And to add to the experience you can also place your tamer in the freezer prior to use for some extra cool vapour.
Each end of this device has a 18mm female glass joint. And all balls can be removed by taking out the silicone plug. This is very handy for cleaning.
Included
1 x Elev8 All Glass Vapour Tamer (Choose Colour)
